legend: Daisy has recently learned divisibility rules for integers and she is fascinated by them. One of the tests she learned is a divisibility test by 3. You can find a sum of all digits of a decimal number and check if the resulting sum is divisible by 3. Moreover, the resulting sum of digits is congruent modulo 3 to the original number — the remainder modulo 3 is preserved. For example, 75≡7+5(mod3)$$$75 \equiv 7 + 5 \pmod 3$$$. Daisy is specifically interested in such remainder preserving divisibility tests.
There are more examples like that that she learned for decimal integers (integers base 10):

To test divisibility modulo 11, find an alternating sum of digits. Counting digits from the last (least significant) digit, add digits on odd positions (the last, 3rd to the last, etc) and subtract digits on even positions (2nd to the last, 4th to the last, etc) to get the sum that is congruent modulo 11 to the original number. For example, 123≡1−2+3(mod11)$$$123 \equiv 1 - 2 + 3 \pmod {11}$$$.
To test divisibility modulo 4, keep the last two digits. Their value is congruent modulo 4 to the original number. For example, 876543≡43(mod4)$$$876543 \equiv 43 \pmod 4$$$.
To test divisibility modulo 7, find an alternating sum of groups of three digits. For example, 4389328≡4−389+328(mod7)$$$4389328 \equiv 4 - 389 + 328 \pmod 7$$$.

Similar tests can be found in other bases. For example, to test divisibility modulo 5 for octal numbers (base 8), find an alternating sum of groups of two digits. For example, 12348≡−128+348(mod5)$$$1234_8 \equiv -12_8 + 34_8 \pmod 5$$$.
Daisy wants to find such rules for a given base b$$$b$$$. She is interested in three kinds of divisibility rules:
Kind 1 — take the last k$$$k$$$ digits of an integer in base b$$$b$$$.
Kind 2 — take a sum of groups of k$$$k$$$ digits of an integer in base b$$$b$$$.
Kind 3 — take an alternating sum of groups of k$$$k$$$ digits of an integer in base b$$$b$$$.

It is not always possible to find such a divisibility rule. For example, in base 10 there is no such test for divisibility modulo 6, even though different approaches to testing divisibility by 6 exist.
Given base b$$$b$$$ and modulo n$$$n$$$, Daisy wants to know the smallest group size k$$$k$$$ for which such a divisibility test exits.
input: There are several tests in the input. The first line of the input contains an integer t$$$t$$$ — the number of tests. The next t$$$t$$$ lines describe the tests.

Each test consists of a line with two integers b$$$b$$$ and n$$$n$$$ — the base and the modulo (b,n≥2$$$b, n \ge 2$$$). The sum of all b$$$b$$$ values in the input does not exceed 106$$$10^6$$$, and the sum of all n$$$n$$$ values in the input does not exceed 106$$$10^6$$$.
output: Write t$$$t$$$ lines — a line for each test in the input. On a line for a test write a single integer 0$$$0$$$ if the divisibility test for a given b$$$b$$$ and n$$$n$$$ does not exist. Otherwise, write two integers a$$$a$$$ and k$$$k$$$, where a$$$a$$$ is the kind of the divisibility test (1, 2, or 3) and k$$$k$$$ is the number of digits in a group for the test, such that k$$$k$$$ is the lowest among all possible divisiblity tests for the given b$$$b$$$ and n$$$n$$$.

legend.ai: Daisy 最近学会了整数的整除规则，并对此着迷。她学会的测试之一是判断一个数是否能被 3 整除。你可以求出一个十进制数所有数位的和，并检查所得的和是否能被 3 整除。此外，数位和与原数模 3 同余——模 3 的余数保持不变。例如，75≡7+5(mod3)$$$75 \equiv 7 + 5 \pmod 3$$$。Daisy 特别感兴趣的是这类保持余数的整除性测试。
她还学会了更多这样的十进制整数（以 10 为底的整数）的例子：
要判断模 11 的整除性，求数位的交错和。按照从最后一位(最低位)开始的顺序编号，将奇数位置上的数位(最后一位、倒数第三位等)相加，并减去偶数位置上的数位(倒数第二位、倒数第四位等)，得到的和与原数模 11 同余。例如，123≡1−2+3(mod11)$$$123 \equiv 1 - 2 + 3 \pmod {11}$$$。
要判断模 4 的整除性，保留最后两位数字。这两位数字组成的数与原数模 4 同余。例如，876543≡43(mod4)$$$876543 \equiv 43 \pmod 4$$$。
要判断模 7 的整除性，求三位一组的数字块的交错和。例如，4389328≡4−389+328(mod7)$$$4389328 \equiv 4 - 389 + 328 \pmod 7$$$。
类似的检验方法也可以在其他进制中找到。例如，要检验八进制数(基数为 8)模 5 的整除性，可以求每两位数字一组的交替和。例如，12348≡−128+348(mod5)$$$1234_8 \equiv -12_8 + 34_8 \pmod 5$$$。
Daisy 希望为给定的基数 b$$$b$$$ 找到这样的规则。她对三类整除规则感兴趣：
类型 1——取一个以 b$$$b$$$ 为基数的整数的最后 k$$$k$$$ 位。
类型 2——将一个以 b$$$b$$$ 为基数的整数按 k$$$k$$$ 位数字一组进行分组，并求各组之和。
类型 3——将一个以 b$$$b$$$ 为基数的整数按 k$$$k$$$ 位数字一组进行分组，并求各组的交替和。
并非总能找到这样的整除规则。例如，在十进制中不存在用于检验模 6 整除性的此类规则，尽管存在其他检验一个数能否被 6 整除的方法。
给定基数 b$$$b$$$ 和模数 n$$$n$$$，Daisy 想知道使得这样的整除性测试存在的最小组大小 k$$$k$$$。

input.ai: 输入包含多组测试。输入的第一行包含一个整数 t$$$t$$$——测试的数量。接下来 t$$$t$$$ 行描述这些测试。
每组测试由一行两个整数 b$$$b$$$ 和 n$$$n$$$ 组成——基数和模数(b,n≥2$$$b, n \ge 2$$$)。输入中所有 b$$$b$$$ 值之和不超过 106$$$10^6$$$，所有 n$$$n$$$ 值之和不超过 106$$$10^6$$$。

output.ai: 输出 t$$$t$$$ 行——对应输入中的每组测试。对于一组测试，如果给定的 b$$$b$$$ 和 n$$$n$$$ 不存在整除性测试，则输出单个整数 0$$$0$$$。否则，输出两个整数 a$$$a$$$ 和 k$$$k$$$，其中 a$$$a$$$ 是整除性测试的种类(1、2 或 3)，k$$$k$$$ 是该测试中一组数字的个数，并且 k$$$k$$$ 是所有针对给定 b$$$b$$$ 和 n$$$n$$$ 的整除性测试中最低的。
